rows.label: qst650441_msg0001
rows.name: Ah, good. You finally found me, mo.

rows.label: qst650441_msg0003
rows.name:
I've got a delivery from Correl-san
in Iyasaki Village, and I was looking
for you, mo!

rows.label: qst650441_msg0004
rows.name: Do you know what's inside, mo?

rows.label: qst650441_msg0006
rows.name:
"Kukuri found a pretty stone in the
Cloud Sea, so I'm sending it to you."

rows.label: qst650441_msg0007
rows.name: That's what the letter said, mo.

rows.label: qst650441_msg0008
rows.name:
By the way, the pretty stone is a
Core Crystal, mo.

rows.label: qst650441_msg0010
rows.name:
Are you looking down on Dokedoke for
doing something unbefitting a courier,
mo?!

rows.label: qst650441_msg0011
rows.name:
Couldn't be helped, mo. If it was
perishable, it'd spoil, so I thought
I'd eat it, mo.

rows.label: qst650441_msg0012
rows.name:
It's your fault for not finding
Dokedoke in the first place, mo.

rows.label: qst650441_msg0013
rows.name:
A-anyway, here's this valuable
Core Crystal, mo.
